description: Represents a single column assignment (one entry of the SQL SET clause).

columnName.description: Target column name or ID to update.

value.description: Literal JSON value to assign to the field in each target document: string, number, boolean, object, array, or null. Omit "value" to remove/unset the field (`undefined`); include \`"value": null\` to store JSON null. Must be a literal constant — no SQL or expressions; value is bound and stored as-is.
